entities.name: Jeyvier Cintrón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jeyvier Jesús Cintrón Ocasio is a Puerto Rican professional boxer who challenged for the WBO junior bantamweight title in 2019. As an amateur, Cintrón represented Puerto Rico at the 2012 and 2016 Olympics as a flyweight.
